reason: Ensures cross-layer publication, Directus, preview, and deployment boundaries are reviewed together.
Checks exact-ID safety, owner-data preservation, immutable media, truthful timestamps, and Directus-backed parity evidence.
Checks that incomplete configuration and unsafe state fail before mutation without leaking secrets.
Checks launch and preview outputs for tokens, bodies, headers, private URLs, and environment leakage.
Checks explicit runtime source wiring, Compose, Caddy, CSP, health, container, and preview trust-boundary evidence.
Provides the frontend verification routing and public/static route invariants.
Checks strict configuration parsing and normalized Directus boundary types.
Checks formatting, lint, typecheck, unit, production/Pagefind build, and Playwright coverage expectations.
Provides the accepted technical direction and the concrete risks the independent reviewer must verify.
